During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] waged a '''pacification''' campaign on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Meastrinnar]]. During the campaign, the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] intercepted a transmission that placed an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] intelligence cell in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Vondrel]]. Acting on the intelligence, a stormtrooper unit led by [[Vin Northal/Legends|Vin Northal]], a member of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guard]] undergoing his customary duty rotation to a front-line combat unit, stormed a structure and neutralized all occupants. However, the ISB had decoded the transmission incorrectly and the cell was located in the sister city of [[Vondrol]]. Northal's unit had stormed an orphanage and massacred the children inside. Instead of admitting their mistake, Northal's superiors and the media portrayed the mission as a military victory. Conflicted over his feelings regarding the deaths of the children, Vin Northal defected to the Alliance.<ref name="CRO-" />
